evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any specific concerns or stress source about the moving process in general?' — asked, but only after the full logistics/multi-stop/inventory intake was done, right before pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer simply answered 'No' to the concerns question, nothing to dig into.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Estimate-variability framing and the self-prep tip both landed ('the better you are at consolidating things into boxes... the less money you end up spending'), but no rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, and no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Handled a genuinely complex move (multi-stop pickup at a relative's house, larger new home) with clear, organized confirmation of every address and inventory detail, and closed the booking successfully.
coaching_note: Two of the five Save Your Ass lines landed but the close never got a 'does that feel fair' pause before asking to book — adding that checkpoint would make the close feel earned rather than assumed, especially on a bigger, pricier move like this one.
